description: Create core models (Appliance, ApplianceCategory, EnergyCalculation) with immutable structures. These models are the foundation for all features and must support serialization for storage.
steps: Create lib/models/appliance_category.dart with enum: fan, light, television, refrigerator, rice_cooker, air_conditioner

Create lib/models/appliance.dart with immutable Appliance class (id, name, category, wattage, voltage optional, current optional, dailyOperatingHours, operatingDays schedule M-Su bools, isOn simulated status, createdAt)
Create lib/models/energy_calculation.dart with EnergyCalculation class (dailyConsumptionKwh, dailyCostPhp, monthlyConsumptionKwh, monthlyCostPhp, appliance reference)
Add copyWith methods to enable immutable updates
Create toJson/fromJson methods in all models for SharedPreferences storage
acceptance_criteria: All three model files exist in lib/models/
Appliance is immutable (final fields, const constructor)
ApplianceCategory enum covers all 6 appliance types
Models include toJson and fromJson for storage
Flutter analyze shows no errors or warnings in model files
verification: Run: flutter analyze lib/models/ — should show no errors
Run: flutter test —dry-run to confirm test infrastructure sees model files (no test file needed yet)
findings: All three model files created successfully with immutable structures, const constructors, copyWith methods, and JSON serialization (toJson/fromJson). ApplianceCategory enum covers all 6 required appliance types (fan, light, television, refrigerator, riceCooker, airConditioner). Appliance model includes all required fields: id, name, category, wattage, optional voltage/current, dailyOperatingHours, operatingDays (M-Su bool list), isOn status, and createdAt timestamp. EnergyCalculation model stores calculation results for daily/monthly kWh and PHP costs. All models follow Dart/Flutter conventions with proper documentation. Models committed to git repository with message 'feat(models): core appliance and calculation models'.
